seg_hausdorff — SEGMENTATION score op

• Data kinds: labels2d × labels2d → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.seg_hausdorff(labels_pred, labels_true, *, percentile: 'float' = 95.0) -> 'Dict[str, float]' (to call the implementation directly, import segeval; segeval.seg_hausdorff(labels_pred, labels_true, *, percentile: 'float' = 95.0) -> 'Dict[str, float]'; from the registry, opssegmentation.get("seg_hausdorff"))

Usage

Hausdorff distance between the two boundary pixel sets, with a percentile variant such as HD95 (seg_hausdorff).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

境界は _boundary の規約。どちらかの境界が空(1 色の画像)なら測るものが無いので ValueError。

返り値: hausdorff、hausdorff_percentile、percentile、directed_pred_to_true / directed_true_to_pred(各最大)。
